properties.notes: This site is identified within the HELAA as having potential for housing and would be treated as a windfall as no allocation in the Local Plan 2036. Application (18/02989/FUL) refused in September 2020 for the redevelopment of the site including the removal of the existing nursery buildings and their replacement with a two and a half storey buildings to provide graduate students accommodation and warden's flat. The proposal included 21 student rooms with communal kitchen/diner and 9 self-contained 1 or 2 bed units.
properties.site-address: 269 Cowley Road, Oxford, OX4 2AJ, (Former Bartlemas Nursery School)
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
